text:
Type: clamp-on gooseneck LED spotlight
Use: task light clamped to a desk or shelf edge, or mounted on a wall; home office, study, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: nickel-plated metal gooseneck arm, small cone spotlight head, metal table clamp
Colors: silver nickel
Shape: tall arching gooseneck that curves over and ends in a tiny cone head, slim vertical stem with a screw clamp at the base, very light and linear
Feel: sleek, practical, discreet
Goes with: white or wood desks, shelving units, grey or white walls; minimalist or modern home offices

product.name: TIVED
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm is adjustable.
